{{ config(materialized='incremental', incremental_strategy='merge',
          unique_key=['league', 'game_date', 'matchup_code']) }}

with r as (
    select s.*, h.team_code as home_code, a.team_code as away_code
    from {{ ref('stg_oddsapi_results') }} s
    left join {{ ref('team_code_map') }} h

    left join {{ ref('team_code_map') }} a
      on a.league = s.league and a.venue = 'oddsapi' and a.venue_code = s.away_team
)

    league,
    game_date,
    concat(least(home_code, away_code), '-', greatest(home_code, away_code)) as matchup_code,
    if(home_score > away_score, home_code, away_code)                        as winner_code,
    last_update                                                              as settled_ts,
    event_id                                                                 as oddsapi_event_id
from r
where home_code is not null and away_code is not null
  and home_score is not null and away_score is not null
  and home_score != away_score          -- ties have no winner (as before)

model.team8_markets.int_oddsapi_consensu.name: int_oddsapi_consensus
model.team8_markets.int_oddsapi_consensu.raw_code:
-- Odds API books collapsed to one row per snapshot x event x team, with the same
-- columns (and order) as stg_polymarket_markets so it unions into int_team_prices.
with devig as (
    select *,
        implied_prob / sum(implied_prob) over w                       as p_devig
    from {{ ref('stg_oddsapi_book_prices') }}
    where implied_prob is not null
    qualify count(*) over w = 2           -- book must price both sides to devig
    window w as (partition by snapshot_ts, event_id, bookmaker)
),
consensus as (
    select
        snapshot_ts, league, event_id, commence_ts, game_date, home_team, away_team, team_name,
        min(p_devig)                                                  as bid,   -- low end of book range
        max(p_devig)                                                  as ask,   -- high end of book range
        avg(p_devig)                                                  as last_price,
        count(distinct bookmaker)                                     as n_books
    from devig
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8
),
coded as (
    select c.*, m.team_code
    from consensus c
    left join {{ ref('team_code_map') }} m
      on m.league = c.league and m.venue = 'oddsapi' and m.venue_code = c.team_name
)
select
    snapshot_ts,
    'oddsapi'                                                         as venue,
    league,
    event_id                                                          as market_id,
    event_id,
    concat(away_team, ' @ ', home_team)                               as market_title,
    team_name,
    team_code,
    game_date,
    concat(min(team_code) over e, '-', max(team_code) over e)         as matchup_code,
    bid,
    ask,
    last_price,
    cast(n_books as numeric)                                          as volume,
    cast(null as numeric)                                             as open_interest,
    commence_ts                                                       as close_ts,
    'open'                                                            as status,
    cast(null as string)                                              as rules_text
from coded
window e as (partition by snapshot_ts, event_id)

model.team8_markets.int_team_prices.name: int_team_prices
model.team8_markets.int_team_prices.raw_code:
with unioned as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_oddsapi_consensus') }}
    union all
    select * from {{ ref('stg_polymarket_markets') }}
),
mapped as (
    select u.* replace (coalesce(m.team_code, u.team_code) as team_code)
    from unioned u
    left join {{ ref('team_code_map') }} m
      on m.league = u.league and m.venue = u.venue and m.venue_code = u.team_code
),
keyed as (
    select *,
        min(team_code) over w as team_a,
        max(team_code) over w as team_b
    from mapped
    window w as (partition by venue, event_id, snapshot_ts)
)
select
    * except (matchup_code, team_a, team_b),
    concat(team_a, '-', team_b)          as matchup_code,   -- sorted, same on both venues
    if(venue = 'oddsapi', last_price, (bid + ask) / 2)   as mid,
    ask - bid                            as spread,
    timestamp_trunc(snapshot_ts, hour)   as snapshot_hour
from keyed
where game_date is not null
  and team_a != team_b                   -- drops events missing one side in a snapshot

-- One row per game x team x PRE-GAME snapshot, with the outcome once known.
-- Grain: league, game_date, matchup_code, team_code, snapshot_hour

with game_meta as (   -- tip-off time and home/away come from the Odds API rows
    select
        league, game_date, matchup_code, team_code,
        max(close_ts)                                                      as commence_ts,
        logical_or(team_name = split(market_title, ' @ ')[safe_offset(1)]) as is_home,
        avg(volume)                                                        as n_books
    from {{ ref('int_team_prices') }}
    where venue = 'oddsapi'
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4
),
pregame as (
    select g.*, m.commence_ts, m.is_home, m.n_books
    from {{ ref('fct_cross_venue_gap') }} g
    join game_meta m
      on m.league = g.league and m.game_date = g.game_date
     and m.matchup_code = g.matchup_code and m.team_code = g.team_code
    -- whole snapshot hour must end before tip-off: no in-game prices
    where timestamp_add(g.snapshot_hour, interval 1 hour) <= m.commence_ts
)
select
    p.league, p.game_date, p.matchup_code, p.team_code, p.snapshot_hour,
    p.commence_ts,
    p.is_home,
    timestamp_diff(p.commence_ts, p.snapshot_hour, minute) / 60.0           as hours_to_start,
    extract(dayofweek from p.commence_ts at time zone 'America/New_York')   as start_dow,
    p.book_mid, p.poly_mid, p.gap, p.abs_gap,
    p.book_spread                                                           as book_range,
    p.poly_spread,
    p.abs_gap > p.poly_spread / 2                                           as outside_spread,
    p.n_books,
    p.book_mid - lag(p.book_mid) over w                                     as book_move,
    p.poly_mid - lag(p.poly_mid) over w                                     as poly_move,
    row_number() over (partition by p.league, p.game_date, p.matchup_code, p.team_code
                       order by p.snapshot_hour desc) = 1                   as is_last_pregame,
    r.winner_code,
    case when r.winner_code is null then null
         when r.winner_code = p.team_code then 1 else 0 end                 as team_won
from pregame p
left join {{ ref('fct_game_result') }} r
  on r.league = p.league and r.game_date = p.game_date and r.matchup_code = p.matchup_code
window w as (partition by p.league, p.game_date, p.matchup_code, p.team_code
             order by p.snapshot_hour)

model.team8_markets.stg_oddsapi_book_pri.raw_code:
with src as (
    select ingested_at, league, payload
    from {{ source('raw', 'market_snapshots') }}
    where venue = 'oddsapi'
),
h2h as (
    select
        s.ingested_at,
        s.league,
        json_value(s.payload, '$.id')                                 as event_id,
        safe.timestamp(json_value(s.payload, '$.commence_time'))      as commence_ts,
        json_value(s.payload, '$.home_team')                          as home_team,
        json_value(s.payload, '$.away_team')                          as away_team,
        json_value(b, '$.key')                                        as bookmaker,
        mkt
    from src s,
        unnest(json_query_array(s.payload, '$.bookmakers')) as b,
        unnest(json_query_array(b, '$.markets')) as mkt
    where json_value(mkt, '$.key') = 'h2h'
)
-- one row per snapshot x event x bookmaker x team
select
    ingested_at                                                       as snapshot_ts,
    'oddsapi'                                                         as venue,
    league,
    event_id,
    bookmaker,
    commence_ts,
    date(commence_ts, 'America/New_York')                             as game_date,
    home_team,
    away_team,
    json_value(o, '$.name')                                           as team_name,
    json_value(o, '$.name') = home_team                               as is_home,
    safe_cast(json_value(o, '$.price') as numeric)                    as decimal_odds,
    safe_divide(1, safe_cast(json_value(o, '$.price') as numeric))    as implied_prob
from h2h, unnest(json_query_array(mkt, '$.outcomes')) as o
where json_value(o, '$.name') in (home_team, away_team)   -- teams only, no draw outcome

model.team8_markets.stg_polymarket_marke.name: stg_polymarket_markets
model.team8_markets.stg_polymarket_marke.raw_code:
with src as (
    select ingested_at, league, payload
    from {{ source('raw', 'market_snapshots') }}
    where venue = 'polymarket'
      and json_value(payload, '$.sportsMarketType') = 'moneyline'
      and regexp_contains(json_value(payload, '$.slug'), r'^[a-z]+-[a-z]+-[a-z]+-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$')   -- single games only
      and safe.parse_date('%Y-%m-%d', regexp_extract(json_value(payload, '$.slug'), r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})$'))
          >= date(ingested_at, 'America/New_York')                                                    -- drop past games
),
base as (
    select
        ingested_at                                                   as snapshot_ts,
        league,
        json_value(payload, '$.id')                                   as market_id,
        json_value(payload, '$.slug')                                 as event_id,
        json_value(payload, '$.question')                             as market_title,
        json_value_array(json_value(payload, '$.outcomes'))           as outcomes,
        json_value_array(json_value(payload, '$.outcomePrices'))      as prices,
        safe_cast(json_value(payload, '$.bestBid') as numeric)        as best_bid,
        safe_cast(json_value(payload, '$.bestAsk') as numeric)        as best_ask,
        safe_cast(json_value(payload, '$.volume') as numeric)         as volume,
        safe_cast(json_value(payload, '$.liquidity') as numeric)      as liquidity,
        safe.parse_date('%Y-%m-%d',
            regexp_extract(json_value(payload, '$.slug'), r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})$'))       as game_date,
        regexp_extract(json_value(payload, '$.slug'), r'^[a-z]+-([a-z]+-[a-z]+)-\d{4}')   as matchup,
        safe.timestamp(json_value(payload, '$.endDate'))              as close_ts,
        json_value(payload, '$.closed')                               as closed,
        json_value(payload, '$.description')                          as rules_text
    from src
)
-- one row per team: outcome 0 uses best bid/ask; outcome 1 is the complement
select
    snapshot_ts,
    'polymarket'                                                      as venue,
    league,
    market_id,
    event_id,
    market_title,
    outcomes[safe_offset(i)]                                          as team_name,
    upper(split(matchup, '-')[safe_offset(i)])                        as team_code,
    game_date,
    upper(replace(matchup, '-', ''))                                  as matchup_code,
    if(i = 0, best_bid, 1 - best_ask)                                 as bid,
    if(i = 0, best_ask, 1 - best_bid)                                 as ask,
    safe_cast(prices[safe_offset(i)] as numeric)                      as last_price,
    volume,
    liquidity                                                         as open_interest,
    close_ts,
    if(closed = 'true', 'closed', 'active')                           as status,
    rules_text
from base, unnest([0, 1]) as i

        max(partition_column) as partition_column,
        max(is_clustering_column) = 1 as is_clustered,
        array_to_string(

macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_column.name: _bigquery__get_columns_sql
macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_column.macro_sql:
{% macro _bigquery__get_columns_sql(db_schema) %}
    select
        columns.table_catalog,
        columns.table_schema,
        columns.table_name as shard_name,
        coalesce(paths.field_path, '<unknown>') as column_name,
        -- invent a row number to account for nested fields
        -- BQ does not treat these nested properties as independent fields
        row_number() over (
            partition by
                columns.table_catalog,
                columns.table_schema,
                columns.table_name
            order by
                columns.ordinal_position,
                paths.field_path
        ) as column_index,
        coalesce(paths.data_type, '<unknown>') as column_type,
        paths.description as column_comment,
        case when columns.is_partitioning_column = 'YES' then 1 else 0 end as is_partitioning_column,
        case when columns.is_partitioning_column = 'YES' then paths.field_path end as partition_column,
        case when columns.clustering_ordinal_position is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_clustering_column,
        case when columns.clustering_ordinal_position is not null then paths.field_path end as cluster_column,
        columns.clustering_ordinal_position
    {# DIVERGENCE BEGIN #}
    from `{{ db_schema.database }}`.`{{ db_schema.schema }}`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS columns
    join `{{ db_schema.database }}`.`{{ db_schema.schema }}`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMN_FIELD_PATHS paths
    {# DIVERGENCE END #}
        on paths.table_catalog = columns.table_catalog
        and paths.table_schema = columns.table_schema
        and paths.table_name = columns.table_name
        and paths.column_name = columns.column_name
    where columns.ordinal_position is not null
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_extend.name: _bigquery__get_extended_catalog_sql
macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_extend.macro_sql:
{% macro _bigquery__get_extended_catalog_sql() %}
    select
        tables.table_catalog as table_database,
        tables.table_schema,
        case
            when tables.is_date_shard then concat(tables.table_name, '*')
            else tables.table_name
        end as table_name,
        tables.table_type,
        tables.table_comment,
        -- coalesce column metadata fields to ensure they are non-null for catalog generation
        -- external table columns are not present in COLUMN_FIELD_PATHS
        coalesce(columns.column_name, '<unknown>') as column_name,
        coalesce(columns.column_index, 1) as column_index,
        coalesce(columns.column_type, '<unknown>') as column_type,
        coalesce(columns.column_comment, '') as column_comment,

        'Shard count' as `stats__date_shards__label`,
        table_stats.shard_count as `stats__date_shards__value`,
        'The number of date shards in this table' as `stats__date_shards__description`,
        tables.is_date_shard as `stats__date_shards__include`,

        'Shard (min)' as `stats__date_shard_min__label`,
        table_stats.shard_min as `stats__date_shard_min__value`,
        'The first date shard in this table' as `stats__date_shard_min__description`,
        tables.is_date_shard as `stats__date_shard_min__include`,

        'Shard (max)' as `stats__date_shard_max__label`,
        table_stats.shard_max as `stats__date_shard_max__value`,
        'The last date shard in this table' as `stats__date_shard_max__description`,
        tables.is_date_shard as `stats__date_shard_max__include`,

        '# Rows' as `stats__num_rows__label`,
        table_stats.row_count as `stats__num_rows__value`,
        'Approximate count of rows in this table' as `stats__num_rows__description`,
        tables.is_table as `stats__num_rows__include`,

        'Approximate Size' as `stats__num_bytes__label`,
        table_stats.size_bytes as `stats__num_bytes__value`,
        'Approximate size of table as reported by BigQuery' as `stats__num_bytes__description`,
        tables.is_table as `stats__num_bytes__include`,

        'Partitioned By' as `stats__partitioning_type__label`,
        column_stats.partition_column as `stats__partitioning_type__value`,
        'The partitioning column for this table' as `stats__partitioning_type__description`,
        column_stats.is_partitioned as `stats__partitioning_type__include`,

        'Clustered By' as `stats__clustering_fields__label`,
        column_stats.clustering_columns as `stats__clustering_fields__value`,
        'The clustering columns for this table' as `stats__clustering_fields__description`,
        column_stats.is_clustered as `stats__clustering_fields__include`

    from tables
    join table_stats
        on table_stats.table_catalog = tables.table_catalog
        and table_stats.table_schema = tables.table_schema
        and table_stats.table_name = tables.table_name
    left join column_stats
        on column_stats.table_catalog = tables.table_catalog
        and column_stats.table_schema = tables.table_schema
        and column_stats.shard_name = table_stats.latest_shard_name
    left join columns
        on columns.table_catalog = tables.table_catalog
        and columns.table_schema = tables.table_schema
        and columns.shard_name = table_stats.latest_shard_name

macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_table_.name: _bigquery__get_table_shards_sql
macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_table_.macro_sql:
{% macro _bigquery__get_table_shards_sql(db_schema) %}
    {% set region = "region-%s"|format(db_schema.identifier)%}
    select
        info_tables.table_catalog as table_catalog,
        info_tables.table_schema as table_schema,
        coalesce(REGEXP_EXTRACT(info_tables.table_name, '^(.+)[0-9]{8}$'), info_tables.table_name) as table_name,
        info_tables.table_name as shard_name,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(info_tables.table_name, '^.+([0-9]{8})$') as shard_index,
        REGEXP_CONTAINS(info_tables.table_name, '^.+[0-9]{8}$') and  info_tables.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' as is_date_shard,
        info_tables.table_type as table_type,
        info_tables.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' as is_table,
        JSON_VALUE(table_description.option_value) as table_comment,
        table_storage.total_logical_bytes as size_bytes,
        table_storage.total_rows as row_count
    from `{{ db_schema.database }}`.`{{ db_schema.schema }}`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES info_tables
    left join `{{ db_schema.database }}`.`{{ db_schema.schema }}`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.MATERIALIZED_VIEWS materialized_views
        on materialized_views.table_catalog = info_tables.table_catalog
        and materialized_views.table_schema = info_tables.table_schema
        and materialized_views.table_name = info_tables.table_name
    left join `{{ db_schema.database }}`.`{{ db_schema.schema }}`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS table_description
        on table_description.table_catalog = info_tables.table_catalog
        and table_description.table_schema = info_tables.table_schema
        and table_description.table_name = info_tables.table_name
        and table_description.option_name = 'description'
    left join `{{ db_schema.database }}`.`{{ region }}`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_STORAGE table_storage
        on table_storage.table_catalog = info_tables.table_catalog
        and table_storage.table_schema = info_tables.table_schema
        and table_storage.table_name = info_tables.table_name
{% endmacro %}

### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand` button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build, or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
